input: A single RGB photograph (social-media / ground-level disaster image), resized to [224, 224] and ImageNet-normalised.
label_representation: class name in the TSV / CSV; integer index via label_mapping.json
notes: MEDIC provides image-level labels only. There are no bounding boxes or segmentation masks in this dataset. xBD is documented separately for future localisation work; it is not required for Part 2 classification.
